newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sandvik buys rest of Britain's RGB.
newsitem.headline: Sandvik buys rest of Britain's RGB.

text.p: Swedish tool and speciality metals maker Sandvik AB said on Wednesday its steel division had increased its stake in British steel distributor RGB and it was now the sole owner of the company.

RGB produces stainless steel tubes, pipes, fittings and sheets mainly for the chemical process, oil and gas industries, Sandvik said in a statement. RGB is based in Birmingham and its 1996 sales totalled 300 million crowns.
Sandvik had held a 55 percent stake in RGB.
"Through this acquisition, we expect to be able to further improve our service to this important sector of the UK market," Sandvik Steel President Per Ericson said in a statement.
